reserveReview.rationale: The retained July 31, 2026 probable reserve envelope is an issuer category description, not a verified current allocation. The September 4 negative search found no current itemized reserve report and the August 31 page metrics cover activity, not reserve composition. Historical metadata only, independently re-fetched October 2: the report as of December 31, 2025 at 21:45 WAT reports Table 2's rounded 43% CardinalStone Money Market Fund (NGN570,689,338 recorded at cost) and 57% bank deposits (NGN768,071,047.79), total NGN1,338,760,385.79. Table 4 separately discloses MMF current value NGN581,844,399.49. Management e-signed January 13, 2026 at 13:11 UTC; the Bala Isah Garba and Company accountant opinion is undated, so January 13 is not asserted as its report publication or independent review date. The schema has no history-only composition field: this historical mix is recorded solely in rationale and source provenance, not reserves, compositionAsOf, reviewedAt, confidence or latestReport. No current allocation, bank identities, eight-chain reconciliation or freshness is inferred; the current missing-reserve charge must remain.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The page does not identify the custodian banks, their allocation shares, account terms, or link a dated reserve examination report; the exact deposit liquidity is therefore unknown.
